releases.title: First public release
releases.summary: 13,673 election records from 17 years (1936 to 1960), 86.1% with a county.

files.label: Research workbooks, one per year (Excel, zipped)
Vote tallies held back for review (CSV)
County codes corrected from the research workbooks (CSV)

notes: An October 2026 review checked every matched election in the 1936 to 1943 and 1947 to 1949 lists against the text of its decision. 1,405 records had been matched to a decision about a different company: 755 now point to the right decision, and 650 have no decision until they are researched. The notes column of each record says what changed.

County codes for 250 records differ from the research workbooks: 178 Connecticut records moved from the 2022 planning regions back to the historical counties, 67 records in independent cities that had been coded as the county of the same name, and 5 records whose county had no code (fixed where the name identified one county, otherwise cleared for research). Each change is listed in county_code_fixes.csv.
40 vote tallies failed a consistency check and are held back until checked by hand.
County names follow the standard name for each FIPS code, so each county is spelled one way.
SIC titles follow one spelling per code (1003 records changed, for example "&" written as "and").

history.title: Wrong matches corrected
history.summary: All 7,224 matched elections in the 1936 to 1943 and 1947 to 1949 lists checked against the text of their decisions. 1,405 had been matched to a different company: 755 moved to the right decision and 650 left for research.

history.title: Accuracy pass and integrity checks
history.summary: Union names re-extracted with case-number checks; a blind audit of 71 records found 87% correct. 23 automated integrity checks pass on all 17 yearly files.

history.title: Eight new variables
history.summary: Added county FIPS codes, NLRB region, SIC major group and division, union name and affiliation, election type, and bargaining unit size.

history.title: Elections only, with match categories
history.summary: Unfair labor practice cases removed, leaving 13,673 election records. Each election re-matched in three tiers, recorded in a new match category column.

history.title: Industry codes and vote tallies
history.summary: Industry read from each decision and coded to the 1987 SIC; vote counts read from published tallies of ballots.

history.title: Pilot years 1950, 1955, and 1960
history.summary: Three later years added from the NLRB decisions index, bringing the total to 15,032 records, 90% with a county.

history.title: 1944 to 1946 added
history.summary: Three years without source lists built directly from the NLRB decisions index: 4,008 cases, 91% to 96% located per year.

history.title: Location claims verified
history.summary: 1,522 uncertain locations checked against independent sources: 505 confirmed and 299 corrected.

history.title: First pass: county identification
history.summary: Elections in the 1936 to 1943 and 1947 to 1949 source lists matched to NLRB decisions, with web research for the rest: 8,757 records, 94% with a county.

planned.title: RA research on missing locations and industries
planned.summary: County, city, and industry for elections the automated pipeline could not place, researched by the project RAs with a source for each.

planned.title: NLRB records from FOIA request 2026-NLFO-01920
planned.summary: Election outcomes and vote tallies from the NLRB's already-scanned records of certified elections before 1961. Request received July 31, 2026; the NLRB extended processing on September 15, 2026.
